import os
import shutil
import requests
EFILING_BASE_URL = os.environ.get('EFILING_BASE_URL', 'https://efile.courts.example.gov/api/v2')
EFILING_LOCAL_DIR = os.environ.get('EFILING_LOCAL_DIR', os.path.join(os.path.expanduser('~'), 'efilings'))

def withdraw_court_efiling_submission(envelope_id: str, reason: str) -> dict:
    response = requests.delete(f'{EFILING_BASE_URL}/envelopes/{envelope_id}', headers={'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.environ['EFILING_API_TOKEN']}"}, json={'withdrawal_reason': reason}, timeout=30)
    result = {'envelope_id': envelope_id, 'status_code': response.status_code, 'withdrawn': response.ok}
    if not response.ok:
        result['error'] = response.text[:500]
    else:
        # Move the local copy of the filing documents from pending to the withdrawn archive
        pending_dir = os.path.join(EFILING_LOCAL_DIR, 'pending', envelope_id)
        if os.path.isdir(pending_dir):
            withdrawn_root = os.path.join(EFILING_LOCAL_DIR, 'withdrawn')
            os.makedirs(withdrawn_root, exist_ok=True)
            archived_path = os.path.join(withdrawn_root, envelope_id)
            shutil.move(pending_dir, archived_path)
            result['local_files_moved_to'] = archived_path
    return result
